## About
C & G Automotive is a local repair shop in Mounds View, MN. Geo and his team take care of brakes, transmissions, engines, shocks and more, and customers know them by name, Carlos included.
Folks come back because we tell it straight. One customer brought in an oil leak another shop refused to fix. We had them drop the car off, then showed them exactly what the problem was and quoted a fair price. Another came in with a leaking radiator hose on his daughter's car, and the owner knew it was still under the dealership's warranty, so he walked out without paying a thing.
We're rated 4.9 from 358 Google reviews. Call today to schedule service or tell us more about your issue.

## Services
- Brake repairs: Brake work done right by our technicians.
- Transmission repairs: Transmission repair, including work like replacing transmission seals.
- Engine work: Engine repairs, from leaks to bigger jobs.
- Shocks and more: Shocks and other suspension work.
- Synthetic blend oil change: A synthetic blend oil change at a set price. ($34.95)
- Brake pad and rotor replacement: Get 15% off when you have the pads and rotors of all four brakes replaced. (15% OFF)
- 21-point inspection: A free 21-point inspection. (FREE)
- Towing service: Ask us about towing when your car can't make it here.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. You'll receive free estimates when you bring your vehicle in for service.

Q: Is your work covered by a warranty?
A: Yes. You get a 12-month / 12,000-mile warranty on parts and labor.

Q: How long have you been around?
A: C & G Automotive was established in 2014.
